min_required_version.description: Minimum required app version. Any client running an older version will be prompted with a non-skippable force update.

latest_recommended_version.description: Latest recommended app version. Clients running older versions will see the update screen with a skip button.

force_update_title.description: Headline displayed on the mandatory force update screen.

defaultValue.value: A vital new version of Wanderline is required to continue documenting your journeys with full offline stability and security. Please update to proceed.

force_update_message.description: Detailed explanation message displayed on the force update screen.

recommended_update_title.description: Headline displayed on the recommended update screen.

defaultValue.value: A new version of Wanderline is ready for you with enhanced field journal features, smoother mapping, and memory optimizations.

recommended_update_message.description: Detailed description displayed on the recommended update screen.

defaultValue.value:
• Offline vault speed & integrity improvements
• Enhanced route waypoint trail drawing
• High-resolution postcard photo exports
• Refined battery and background sync consumption

update_release_notes.description: Newline-separated bullet points or feature highlights shown on the update screen.

update_store_url_android.description: Google Play Store destination URL for Android devices.

update_store_url_ios.description: Apple App Store destination URL for iOS / iPadOS / macOS devices.

allow_recommended_skip.description: Whether users are allowed to skip recommended updates and proceed into the app.

is_maintenance_mode.description: Global maintenance switch. When true, blocks normal app usage and redirects all clients to the maintenance screen.

maintenance_title.description: Title displayed on the maintenance screen.

defaultValue.value: We are currently polishing the expedition trail to keep your field journals secure and dependable. Please check back shortly.

maintenance_message.description: Descriptive message displayed on the maintenance screen.

maintenance_start_time.description: Timestamp or human-readable start time of the maintenance window (e.g. '10:00 UTC').

maintenance_end_time.description: Estimated completion time of maintenance (e.g. '12:00 UTC').

maintenance_support_email.description: Support email recipient address displayed on the maintenance screen.

maintenance_status_url.description: URL to public service status page.

maintenance_bypass_key.description: Secret emergency authorization passphrase allowing developers and QA to bypass maintenance mode.
